tools_helpful.evidence: dotnet build succeeded with 0 warnings / 0 errors; namespace migration and manifest Windows.Desktop/rescap/runFullTrust edits were all applied correctly (score notes: winui_build_status success).

tools_problematic.problem: Passed the manifest even though it still contained a UWP out-of-process windows.backgroundTasks Extension that blocks package registration (0x80080204). The static manifest check only verifies TargetDeviceFamily/rescap/runFullTrust, not background-task extensions.
tools_problematic.evidence: migration-score.json winui_launch_status: MSIX registration error 0x80080204 at Package.appxmanifest line 37, yet build+validator reported success.

tool_limitations.limitation: A 0x80080204 manifest-validation failure never registers the app (no AUMID, no PID), so Test-AppLaunch classifies it as status=unavailable (env issue) and the smoke launch only WARNs — it cannot fail a manifest-registration defect.
tool_limitations.suggested_tweak: Catch invalid windows.backgroundTasks Extensions with a deterministic static manifest check in section 5b, before launch.

failed_apis.why_tried: Carried over verbatim from the UWP Package.appxmanifest (EntryPoint="Tasks.SampleBackgroundTask" / "Tasks.ServicingComplete").
failed_apis.root_cause: A packaged WinUI 3 desktop (Win32) app cannot host an out-of-process WinRT background-task server declared with EntryPoint alone; the registrar requires an ActivatableClassId under windows.activatableClass.inProcessServer, otherwise it rejects the package with 0x80080204.
failed_apis.fix: Remove the <Extension Category="windows.backgroundTasks" EntryPoint=...> elements from the manifest and migrate the task code to the WinAppSDK model (BackgroundTaskBuilder / Task Scheduler / push activation).

doc_errors.wrong: Covers only the code API swap (IBackgroundTask -> BackgroundTaskBuilder). Says nothing about the manifest, so the agent left the invalid UWP windows.backgroundTasks Extension in place.
doc_errors.correct: Must also instruct removal/rework of the <Extension Category="windows.backgroundTasks"> manifest declaration, which fails packaged-desktop registration with 0x80080204.

special_apis.special_handling: UWP declares background tasks in-manifest pointing at a separate WinRT Component project; this out-of-process model is invalid for packaged WinUI 3 desktop and must be dropped from the manifest, not just the code.

errors_encountered.error: 0x80080204 App manifest validation error at Package.appxmanifest line 37: 'not allowed to have EntryPoint="Tasks.SampleBackgroundTask" without ActivatableClassId in windows.activatableClass.inProcessServer'
errors_encountered.root_cause: Leftover UWP windows.backgroundTasks Extension with out-of-process EntryPoint in the migrated manifest.
errors_encountered.fix: Delete the windows.backgroundTasks Extension(s); migrate task code per the WinAppSDK background-task strategy.

dev_agent_struggles.symptom: App builds cleanly but every scenario is dead — package never registers.
dev_agent_struggles.turns_or_retries: not caught during the trial (build+validator both green)
dev_agent_struggles.root_cause: Agent migrated code namespaces and the Windows.Desktop/rescap/runFullTrust manifest bits but copied the windows.backgroundTasks Extension verbatim from UWP.
dev_agent_struggles.preventable_by: A static manifest check in Validate-UwpMigration.ps1 that FAILs on a leftover windows.backgroundTasks Extension, plus explicit prose in the Background Tasks section + Manifest checklist to remove it.

missing_tooling.need: Static manifest lint for UWP-only Extensions (windows.backgroundTasks) that break packaged-desktop registration.
missing_tooling.would_have_saved: The entire score — the defect is invisible to the build and to the runtime smoke launch (which downgrades registration failures to WARN).
